title: Upward Technologies opens sign-up for ERIS design partners
content_html:
On 25 September 2026, Upward Technologies announced ERIS and opened sign-up for design partners.

ERIS brings ten core business tools into one app on one login. The tools include a main portal with the ERIS Assistant, meetings, meeting notes and note taker, task manager, project management, team chat, CRM, document management, document signing, and email. Every AI action is logged.

The software will run in Upward's cloud or on-premise. The beta starts on 16 November 2026 with design partners, and the official release follows on 11 January 2027. ERIS is not available yet.

Companies can now sign up to become design partners for the upcoming beta.
